### ApiResponse kwarg-collision validation (validate_http_status!)

`ApiResponse#render_success` declares `status:` as an HTTP-status kwarg and collects other kwargs as data via `**extra_data`. If a caller passes a payload field literally named `status:` (e.g. `status: "healthy"`), the string is silently captured as the HTTP status, coerced via `.to_i` to `0`, and Puma emits `HTTP/1.1 0 CUSTOM` on the wire.
